entities.name: Yves-Alexandre de Marbeuf
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yves-Alexandre de Marbeuf was a French bishop of Autun and archbishop of Lyon, and statesman. He was an opponent of the European Enlightenment thinking, and of Jansenism.
